claims: Check if the wall socket or board has power using another device.
Reset the circuit breaker or replace the fuse if it has tripped.
Avoid plugging high-wattage heaters into standard low-capacity boards.

claims.text: If the extension board overload breaker tripped, switch off and unplug everything from the board, then press the reset button once or switch the board off and on.
Plug devices back one at a time and avoid running a heater, iron, and kettle together.
